title: Clarifying Offline Access and Camera Upload for a team

question.author: member_129
question.body: Before I explain offline access and camera upload to my team, what should I verify in the official guide?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Mobile Apps documentation says: Camera uploads count against your storage quota and can be paused per network. Mark any file or folder as "Available offline" to pin a copy on the device; pinned items stay in sync over Wi-Fi by default. Camera upload sends new photos and videos from your device to the Camera Uploads folder automatically, in original quality. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
